reviews.title: Great Product!
reviews.comment:
Can't complain, looks nice, does not feel cheep, the sound is very exceptional, good quality, seamless recording, works great!
Plugged it into my windows computer and it worked with no issues, compatible.
Price is reasonable, I believe it is very worth it.
reviews.author: Patsy

reviews.title: Excellent price to quality.
reviews.comment: This is a great and cheap microphone that is easy to use. From what my friends say on discord, I sound very clear and loud enough. Though one caveat, my microphone did brick from an update, however Hyperx did the right thing and replaced mine once i showed them I ordered it on amazon. Do keep in mind that you should keep your box but I doubt HyperX would reject you. It's easy to use, very plug in and play, it works. I do use a microphone arm that I got for cheap.
reviews.author: Jin Hong
